name: File and Artifact Synchronization
description: Sync files and artifacts between devices using content-addressed storage with chunking and deduplication.
purpose: Enable efficient, bandwidth-aware file and artifact sync across devices using content addressing, chunking, and deduplication.
acceptanceCriteria: Large files are split into chunks for incremental transfer.
Transfer supports compression for bandwidth efficiency.
Integrity verification (hash check) on every transfer.
Sync respects .gitignore and configurable file filters.
